sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned Public Prosecutor and perused the material available on the record.

Petitioner has filed this petition u/s 438 CrPC apprehending his arrest in connection with FIR No.222/2017 registered at Police Station Kaman, District Bharatpur for the offences punishable u/s 420, 272 of IPC and sec. 58, 59 of Food Safety and Standard Act.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has contended that petitioner has falsely been implicated in this case, he carries on business of milk dairy and on information of apprehended co- accused persons,
petitioner is apprehending his arrest, petitioner is innocent, his prestige will be maligned, if he is taken into custody, he is prepared to co-operate with the Investigating (2 of 2) [CRLMB-1345/2018]
Agency, so he be granted pre-arrest bail.

Learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application and has contended that the raid party has apprehended two accused persons, while preparing synthetic cheese by obnoxious material and petitioner absconded from the spot, synthetic material has been found not conforming to food safety standards, as such is injurious for the health of consumers, so the petitioner be not given benefit of pre-arrest bail.

Perusal of case diary discloses that milk (loose) and milk powder (loose) and skimmed milk powder,
which have been recovered, have been found to be non conforming to food safety Regulations,
during the course of arguments learned counsel for the petitioner has candidly admitted that present petitioner is owner of the factory but he does carry on business of dairy.
Recovered synthetic cheese would have certainly caused harm to human beings.
